Meta.title: IT Shaharcha — Youth Information Technology Center
Meta.description: IT Shaharcha is a free state IT center for young people (PQ-178): programming, mobile and web development, graphic design, robotics, 3D printing, English and computer literacy. In-person classes, 24/7 coworking, certificates.
Meta.ogAlt: IT Shaharcha — the little city of future professions

experience.q: Can I join with no experience?
experience.a: Yes. The course starts from zero and we cover the basics together in the first lessons.

laptop.q: Do I need my own computer?
laptop.a: Classes run in the center’s equipped classrooms, and a computer is provided. Having your own helps for practice at home.

missed.q: What if I miss a class?
missed.a: Arrange extra time with your mentor or work through the topic in the coworking space.

certificate.a: Yes, students who complete the course receive an IT Shaharcha certificate.

free.a: No. Every course is free for school students, and computer literacy is free at any age for people who are not officially employed. Otherwise, leave an application and a manager will check the options.

Free.title: Who studies for free?
Free.lead: Under Presidential Decree PQ-178 of 15 May 2024, “IT-shaharcha” centers give young people in the regions the conditions to learn digital technologies and foreign languages for free. Toshloq district of Fergana region (Yangiyo‘l mahalla) is on the decree’s list.

unemployed.title: Not officially employed
unemployed.text: The computer literacy course is free at any age.

other.text: Leave an application and a manager will check what’s available for you.

Free.forSchoolAndUnemployed: Free for school students and anyone not officially employed (any age)
Free.source: Decree text: lex.uz, PQ-178, 15.05.2024. Eligibility by group is the center’s own rule.
